posts.t: Jason Zucker has been activated and added to the Sabres' roster. Sam Carrick has been placed on injured reserve.
Justin Danforth and Sam Carrick are being evaluated, Lindy Ruff said. Carrick is dealing with a mid-body injury, “possibly might be related” to last season’s injury.

Jason Zucker is working with the second power play unit at Sabres practice today. 

Justin Danforth and Sam Carrick aren’t on the ice

Good morning from Harborcenter.

Don’t see Sam Carrick. Justin Danforth (upper body) also remains absent.
